method: Read-only SQLite snapshot; all current and archived account positions reconciled with order and embedded fill ledgers. API summaries use the same exclusive cutoff. No trades modified.
limitations: Internal consistency is not execution proof.
173 current-period positions (closed and open) have candle-model maker entry receipts; these are not verified exchange fills.
Stored peak R combines price-only trailing peaks and marked P&L samples. It cannot establish net executable peak profit or retained-profit percentage.
Reset archives are excluded from current-period totals; including them is a historical aggregate, not current account equity.
The four zero-volume candle receipts require per-trade tape analysis; one ZEC example has earlier fresh crossing prints, so zero volume alone does not prove a fabricated fill.
